name: KisanSetu AI
description: AI-powered cotton & groundnut market linkage platform for Gujarat farmers. Connects smallholder farmers to buyers, provides mandi price forecasts, quality grading, storage advice, and income dashboards — powered by IBM Granite (watsonx.ai).

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Automatically set when the databases-for-postgresql addon is provisioned. Format: postgresql://user:password@host:port/dbname

IBM_API_KEY.description: IBM Cloud IAM API key for watsonx.ai / IBM Granite access. Obtain from https://cloud.ibm.com → Manage → Access (IAM) → API keys. App runs in deterministic fallback mode without this.

IBM_PROJECT_ID.description: watsonx.ai project ID. Obtain from https://dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com → Projects. Required together with IBM_API_KEY to enable Granite.

IBM_GRANITE_MODEL.description: IBM Granite model ID to use for AI inference.

IBM_REGION.description: IBM Cloud region where your watsonx.ai instance is hosted.

SECRET_KEY.description: Random secret key used for JWT signing. Must be at least 32 characters. Generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

JWT_ALGORITHM.description: Algorithm used to sign JWT tokens.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (no spaces). Set to your frontend URL in production.

NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.description: Public URL of the backend API, baked into the Next.js bundle at build time. Must be set before building the frontend image.

MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER.description: Market data source. Use 'demo' for built-in synthetic data (no external API needed) or 'live' for real AgMarkNet/eNAM data (requires MARKET_API_KEY).

MARKET_API_KEY.description: API key for AgMarkNet/eNAM live market data. Only required when MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER=live.

QUALITY_UPLOAD_DIR.description: Directory path for storing quality-grading image uploads.
